rationale: DISP-003: surge rose from 1.0x to 1.5x between the quote and the trip start and the rider was not notified (SURGE-1), so the surge differential is refunded in full (SURGE-2): (1.5 − 1.0) × $9.00 surgeable subtotal = $4.50 (SURGE-3). The sample states the rider's request ($4.50), not an expected ruling; this is the official policy §3.3 applied to it.
